title: 13 Squid Cheren Blackcurrant Menthol 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Cheren Blackcurrant Menthol from 13 Squid is a deliciously rich and tangy Blackcurrant flavour e-juice that layers bold forest fruit notes over the palate on the inhale, followed by that icy cool refreshment from menthol on the exhale, creating a luxuriously decadent taste chased by a touch of frost. This product contains 100ml of e-liquid in a 120ml shortfill bottle, with space for 2 x 10ml nicotine shots to let you tailor your e juice’s nicotine content. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. The e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mods and sub-ohm tanks , producing rich clouds and immaculate flavour.
